page.title: Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise Marbella 2030: Morning at Sea

data.meta_description: Book a Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2030 from Puerto Banús. 2h morning trip, €749 for 9 guests, with skipper, drinks & snacks included.
data.summary: A 2-hour morning dolphin watching brunch cruise from Puerto Banús, Marbella, aboard the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. Includes licensed skipper, fuel, soft drinks, beer, wine, cava, light snacks, and Spanish VAT.
key_facts: Skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks & IVA included
Best dolphin sightings: May–October, calm mornings
Free cancellation up to 48h before departure

faq.q: What is included in the Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2030?
faq.a: The cruise includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just need to bring sunscreen and a camera.

faq.q: Which boats are used for the dolphin watching brunch cruise?
faq.a: We use either the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, max 9 guests) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, max 11 guests). Both depart from Puerto Banús and are equipped for comfortable morning cruising.

faq.q: What time does the brunch cruise depart?
faq.a: The standard departure is 10:00 from Puerto Banús, returning around 12:00. We can also arrange a 9:30 start on request. The 2-hour window is ideal for dolphin sightings and light breakfast at sea.

faq.q: When is the best time of year for dolphin watching in Marbella?
faq.a: Dolphin sightings are most frequent between May and October, when the sea is calm and water temperatures rise. Mornings—especially before 11:00—offer the best visibility and wildlife activity.

faq.q: Can I see dolphins on every cruise?
faq.a: While we see dolphins on the majority of trips, we cannot guarantee sightings. The Costa del Sol has resident pods of common and striped dolphins, and our skippers know the best areas. If we don't spot any, you still enjoy a scenic brunch cruise.

faq.q: Is the brunch cruise suitable for children?
faq.a: Yes, the cruise is family-friendly. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are stable and safe for children. Life jackets are provided for all ages. The soft drinks and snacks menu appeals to younger guests.

faq.q: How do I book the dolphin watching brunch cruise?
faq.a: You can book via WhatsApp on our website. We require a deposit to secure the date. The full balance is due 48h before departure. Free cancellation is available up to 48h in advance.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: If the forecast shows strong winds or rough seas, we will contact you to reschedule or offer a full refund. Your safety is our priority. The skipper makes the final call on the morning of the cruise.

data.body_html:
Start your day on the Costa del Sol with a Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2030 — a 2-hour morning trip from Puerto Banús aboard a premium motor yacht. Spot wild dolphins in their natural habitat while enjoying a light breakfast with cava, beer, and soft drinks. The cruise departs at 10:00 and returns by midday, leaving the rest of the day free for beach or sightseeing. Priced at €749 for up to 9 guests, all inclusive — skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden extras.

Why book a dolphin watching brunch cruise in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline — from the cliffs of Cabopino to the golden sands of Estepona — is a feeding ground for common and striped dolphins. Morning cruises offer the calmest sea conditions and the best chance of sightings. The Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2030 combines wildlife with a relaxed onboard brunch: light snacks, fresh fruit, and your choice of cava, white wine, beer, or soft drinks. It’s a family-friendly activity that works for couples, small groups, and solo travellers alike.

Which boat will we use?

You’ll cruise on either the Astondoa 40 (12.5 metres, max 9 passengers) or the Azimut 39 (12.5 metres, max 11 passengers). Both are modern, well-maintained motor yachts that depart from Puerto Banús. Each comes with a shaded cockpit, forward sunpad, and onboard restroom. The skipper handles all navigation, so you can relax and focus on the horizon.

What’s included in the price?

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the 2-hour cruise
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, fruit, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no surprises

The total is €749. No extra fees for cleaning, port taxes, or crew tips.

When is the best time for dolphin sightings?

Peak season runs from May to October, when the Mediterranean is warm and calm. Mornings — especially between 9:30 and 11:30 — offer the best light and the highest chance of spotting pods. Our skippers know the local waters well: we often head towards Cala del Faro or the waters off Río Verde, where dolphins feed on small fish. Sightings are common but never guaranteed.

What about the brunch?

The brunch is light and European-style: think fresh fruit, Spanish olives, crisps, nuts, and finger sandwiches. Drinks include chilled cava, white wine, beer, and a selection of soft drinks. It’s not a full cooked breakfast — the focus is on keeping things easy and elegant at sea. You’re welcome to bring your own food if you have dietary requirements.

How to book your Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise 2030

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp on the [Boat Rental Marbella](/). We’ll confirm availability for your preferred date. A deposit secures the booking, with the balance due 48 hours before departure. Free cancellation is available up to 48 hours before the cruise. We recommend booking at least a week in advance during July and August.
